# BorderExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for borders

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Border`](#border): Adds a border to the element with the specified color and uniform width
- [`BorderBottom`](#borderbottom): Adds a bottom border to the element
- [`BorderHorizontal`](#borderhorizontal): Adds horizontal borders (left and right) to the element
- [`BorderLeft`](#borderleft): Adds a left border to the element
- [`BorderRight`](#borderright): Adds a right border to the element
- [`BorderTop`](#bordertop): Adds a top border to the element
- [`BorderVertical`](#bordervertical): Adds vertical borders (top and bottom) to the element
